outcomes.name: preflight reads both exact subscription paths without creating profiles, changing settings or submitting tasks
preflight excludes only a version-bound Factory task proven to belong to another workspace
preflight keeps same-workspace, missing and mismatched Factory scope proofs blocked
preflight does not convert current-workspace failed or blocked Factory tasks into terminal tasks
preflight does not request scope details for already settled Factory tasks
foreign historical Factory tasks remain untouched while failed owned acceptance still cancels its task
a default team switches only this login session to its verified personal workspace before reading Coordinator
workspace selection rejects ambiguous choices, teams and another account personal membership before switching
workspace switch acknowledgement and cookie readback failures stop before Coordinator and close the session
unsafe configuration blocks before any model call and reports only closed failure codes
two executed cases retain exact native receipts, restore model/profile state and never fabricate replay evidence
successful terminal runs close only their own machines and retain task evidence
a missing machine requires a fresh owned run and an explicit null machine read
machine failures never turn a completed task green and do not prevent closing another owned machine
legacy Factory tasks still require review and verify before the normal deliverable acceptance
missing, failed or stale Factory checks never reach approval, including legacy verify
deliverable approval requires its receipt, never accepts a repository and never retries a lost response
uncertain mutation responses never resubmit and still reconcile own temporary settings
wrong provider/model and an extra native attempt stop the case without retrying
pure source and budget guards reject shared credentials, inherited model choices and retries
cleanup preserves a concurrent model edit and reports incomplete restoration
prepare is explicit, requires execution and restores only its acknowledged settings
prepare refuses owner-wide activity and inherited model choices without changing settings
a blocked case does not prevent preparation and execution of another available model
preparation failures restore acknowledged writes but never guess after a lost response
restoration failures and concurrent edits remain visible without overwriting them
issue inventory follows real opaque cursors beyond 100 rows and rejects a moving scan
browser submission requires one executed case and does not authenticate on invalid options
browser mode publishes readiness then observes the real-shaped UI click through push without an API submission
browser waiting times out or blocks changed UI text without sending or repeating a task
live transport waits for actual invalidations, rejects disconnects and keeps capabilities out of reports
implicit default preflight requires server absence evidence and never writes a preference
implicit default restores absence with the stored binding and revision, not the catalogue option
implicit default never overwrites a preference created after preflight
implicit default stops after a lost or incomplete first selection receipt without guessing ownership
implicit default preserves a same-value concurrent rewrite when the revision no longer matches
implicit default checks absence once after a lost restoration response and does not repeat deletion
